annotations.title: JSON validator, validate JSON: check whether text is valid JSON and where the error is

description: Check whether text is valid JSON. Returns valid true/false, the parsed value's type and size, and for invalid input the error message with line and column. Use before parsing an LLM's or an API's output. Example: text={"a":1}. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
